critical_blockers_status.original_issue: No Login or Registration UI exists in frontend. localStorage token is never populated.
critical_blockers_status.resolution: Implemented LoginView.tsx, SignupView.tsx, useAuthStore.ts, ProtectedRoute.tsx, and PublicOnlyRoute.tsx. Token persisted in localStorage and hydrated on app mount.

critical_blockers_status.original_issue: Universal silent mock fallbacks in apiHooks.ts mask 401, 404, 422 errors with static fixtures.
critical_blockers_status.resolution: Completely rewrote apiHooks.ts, removing all silent mock fallbacks. Added authentic query/mutation hooks with typed error handling.

critical_blockers_status.original_issue: POST /api/v1/work parameter casing mismatch drops effort to 0.0h and deadline to null.
critical_blockers_status.resolution: Added @model_validator in backend/app/schemas/work.py normalizing camelCase (deadlineUtc, estimatedEffortHours) to snake_case.

critical_blockers_status.original_issue: Effort estimation endpoint sends work_title instead of title, causing HTTP 422 error.
critical_blockers_status.resolution: Updated backend/app/services/ai/schemas.py with field alias supporting both title and work_title.

critical_blockers_status.original_issue: Tracking routes in apiHooks.ts use singular /tracking/session/* instead of plural /tracking/sessions/*.
critical_blockers_status.resolution: Standardized all tracking hooks to plural /tracking/sessions/* and added manual entry derivation in POST /tracking/entries.
